title: Sharp_By_VeilRunnerYT
description: Clean and sharp PvP swords texture pack.
body:
Sharp By VeilRunnerYT is a clean and stylish PvP texture pack focused on sharp, minimal sword designs.
This pack replaces all default Minecraft swords with smooth, high-visibility textures that are perfect for PvP and survival gameplay.

✨ Features:

Custom textures for all swords

Clean and sharp PvP look

Lightweight and performance friendly

Works great for survival and PvP

If you enjoy simple and sharp visuals, this pack is made for you!
